constraints.name: canonical_trust_transactions_decision_outcome_review_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((decision_outcome_review IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(decision_outcome_review) = 'object'::text) AND (decision_outcome_review ? 'originalDecision'::text) AND ((decision_outcome_review ->> 'originalDecision'::text) = decision) AND (decision_outcome_review ? 'evaluationStatus'::text) AND ((decision_outcome_review ->> 'evaluationStatus'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPORTED'::text, 'CONTRADICTED'::text, 'HUMAN_OVERRIDDEN'::text, 'PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED'::text, 'UNRESOLVED'::text])) AND ((NOT (decision_outcome_review ? 'adjudicatedOutcome'::text)) OR ((decision_outcome_review -> 'adjudicatedOutcome'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((decision_outcome_review ->> 'adjudicatedOutcome'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['ALLOW'::text, 'REVIEW'::text, 'DENY'::text]))) AND ((NOT (decision_outcome_review ? 'humanOverride'::text)) OR ((decision_outcome_review -> 'humanOverride'::text) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((jsonb_typeof((decision_outcome_review -> 'humanOverride'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND ((decision_outcome_review #>> '{humanOverride,occurred}'::text[]) = 'true'::text) AND ((decision_outcome_review #>> '{humanOverride,originalDecision}'::text[]) = decision) AND ((decision_outcome_review #>> '{humanOverride,resultingDecision}'::text[]) = ANY (ARRAY['ALLOW'::text, 'REVIEW'::text, 'DENY'::text]))))))) NOT VALID
